mechanism: gonadotropin releasing factor hormone receptor agonist

analogy.mechanism: gonadotropin releasing factor hormone receptor agonist
analogy.rationale: GNRHR and LHCGR are GPCRs expressed almost exclusively in pituitary and gonadal tissues, which are not represented among these nine cell lines, so agonists should elicit little to no transcriptional response. Other GPCR-targeting classes acting on receptors absent from these cells would similarly show minimal response.
